question: What effect can association with such a place have on knowledge and yoga?
premises: In certain places knowledge and yoga are established in a fixed way.
Even a being made of consciousness can fall into sinfulness.
Such a fall can occur through association with others in that place.
inference: Association with a particular place and its people can degrade even established knowledge and yoga.
uncertainties: The sandhi resolution of yathācātanmayo@pyeti follows the supplied tokenization and may admit minor variation.
plain_english: In some such place, knowledge and yoga may be established by fixed rule, yet even one who is made of consciousness can fall into sinfulness through association with those there.
